protocol.title: Extracellular Vesicle microRNA Quantification from Plasma Using an Integrated Microfluidic Device
protocol.platform: Integrated microfluidics (SAW lysing chip + IEM concentration/sensing chip)
protocol.objective: PCR-free absolute quantification of free-floating and EV-contained miR-21 from untreated plasma using SAW-based EV lysis and IEM electrokinetic concentration/sensing

chip_1.name: SAW lysing chip
chip_1.signal_source: Agilent 33250A function generator + E&I 325LA RF amplifier

CEM.role: Create depletion zone to concentrate negatively charged miRNA upstream

AEM.composition: Polystyrene-divinylbenzene with strong basic quaternary ammonium groups; polyethylene binder; polyamide/polyester textile fiber support
AEM.role: Sensor: oligoprobe-functionalized; hybridisation of target miRNA shifts CVC over-limiting region
AEM.functionalization: Complementary ssDNA oligoprobe amine-coupled to AEM surface

interconnect.purpose: Direct lysate transfer from SAW chip to concentration/sensing chip with no sample loss

buffers.PBS_1x: Phosphate buffered saline 1x (Fischer Scientific); sample injection and driver fluid
buffers.PBS_4x: 4x PBS; post-hybridisation wash to remove non-hybridised species from AEM surface
buffers.PBS_01x: 0.1x PBS; channel and reservoir fill during CVC measurement sweeps
buffers.TAE_10x: 400 mM Tris-acetate + 10 mM EDTA (Fischer Scientific); electrode reservoir buffer

man_made_probe.type: Amine-coupled ssDNA with no known miR complement

spike_in_control.name: C. elegans miR-39 miRNA mimic (cel-mir-39-3p)
spike_in_control.use: RT-qPCR normalization control; added during miRNA extraction

liver_cancer_mouse.cancer_type: Spontaneous hepatocellular carcinoma (Pten deletion in hepatic cells)
liver_cancer_mouse.ethics: Approved by University of Southern California IACUC

clinical_human_serum.source: University of Southern California tissue bank

calibration.target: Synthetic miR-21 (Integrated DNA Technologies) in 1x PBS
calibration.benchmark: Results validated against conventional RT-qPCR; nearly identical expression levels

steps.name: IEM sensor functionalization and baseline CVC
steps.notes: AEM sensor functionalized with complementary ssDNA oligoprobe (TCAACATCAGTCTGATAAGCTA) via standard amine-coupling before use. Baseline CVC acquired for probe-only in 1x PBS; used as Delta-V reference for all subsequent measurements. CVC sweep: 0-2.5 V via Gamry 500 potentiostat.

steps.name: Measurement 1 - Free-floating miR-21 (SAW OFF)
steps.operation: mix (channel flow abstraction; SAW device OFF)
steps.notes: 20 uL untreated plasma injected with SAW OFF; EVs remain intact. Sample flows through SAW chip channel (acoustically bypassed) and directly into concentration/sensing chip under 60 uL PBS driver. Only free-floating miR-21 reaches the AEM sensor.

steps.name: IEM concentration - Measurement 1
steps.notes: 200 V DC applied across CEM reservoir for 20 min. Depletion zone forms upstream of AEM sensor; negatively charged free-floating miR-21 concentrates directly beneath sensor surface. Hybridisation with oligoprobe occurs concurrently during this 20-min window. Modelled as heat at 25 C for 1200 s (ambient temperature; no thermal step).

steps.name: Post-hybridisation wash and CVC buffer exchange - Measurement 1
steps.wash_purpose: Remove non-hybridised species from AEM sensor surface
steps.cvc_buffer_purpose: Low ionic strength maximises Delta-V in over-limiting current region
steps.notes: 4x PBS wash followed by 0.1x PBS pump-in before CVC sweep. Channel and electrode reservoirs filled with 0.1x PBS at time of measurement.

steps.name: CVC sweep - Free-floating miR-21 Delta-V measurement
steps.instrument: Gamry 500 potentiostat; 0-2.5 V sweep; Ag-AgCl reference electrodes
steps.notes: Concentration voltage terminated before sweep. Delta-V in over-limiting region recorded and correlated to free-floating miR-21 concentration via calibration curve.

steps.name: Measurement 2 - Total miR-21 (SAW ON; free-floating + EV-miRNA)
steps.operation: mix (SAW channel flow + acoustic lysis) + detect (sawLysingDetection)
steps.notes: Fresh 20 uL plasma aliquot injected with SAW active (28 MHz, 1 W). SAWs refract perpendicularly into polycarbonate microchannel and generate acoustic pressure shearing EVs open. ~1 min residence at 250 uL/h achieves ~100% EV lysis (50% more efficient than TRIzol chemical lysis). Released EV-miRNA and free-floating miRNA both flow into concentration/sensing chip. sawLysingDetection confirms lysis before IEM processing.

steps.name: IEM concentration - Measurement 2
steps.notes: Disposable AEM sensor replaced between runs to maintain repeatability. 200 V DC for 20 min; total miRNA pool (free-floating + EV-released) concentrates and hybridises with fresh oligoprobe.

steps.name: Post-hybridisation wash and CVC buffer exchange - Measurement 2
steps.notes: Identical wash and buffer exchange procedure as Measurement 1.

steps.name: CVC sweep - Total miR-21 Delta-V measurement
steps.instrument: Gamry 500 potentiostat; 0-2.5 V sweep; Ag-AgCl reference electrodes
steps.ev_mirna_quantification: EV-miR-21 fraction = difference in Delta-V between Measurement 2 (total) and Measurement 1 (free-floating); converted to concentration via calibration equation
steps.notes: Total miRNA Delta-V expected ~6x higher than free-floating alone in healthy plasma. EV-miRNA is consistently more abundant than free-floating miR-21 in both human and mouse plasma.

clinical_results.liver_cancer_human_serum_fold_overexpres: ~13 (vs healthy human; no overlap between groups)

negative_controls.description: Bare (non-functionalized) AEM sensor exposed to unlysed and SAW-lysed plasma; no measurable voltage shift
Plasma diluted 1:1 with 1x PBS; voltage shift decreases from 0.65 V to 0.6 V as expected
Non-target miR-196a (1 uM spike); negligible voltage shift of 0.1 V (below sensor measurement limit)
Man-made probe with no known miR complement; voltage shift 0.08 V for both unlysed and SAW-lysed plasma (below sensor limit)
RNAse-treated plasma (free RNA digested); no target miR-21 detected, confirming free-floating signal specificity
Protease-added SAW-lysed plasma (proteins eliminated); similar voltage shift to non-protease-treated sample, confirming no protein fouling of IEM sensor

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Baseline CVC; Measurement 1 (SAW OFF); IEM concentration; wash; CVC sweep; if freefloatSignal

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: Dispose QC signals; Measurement 2 (SAW ON); SAW lysis; IEM concentration; wash; CVC sweep; if totalSignal

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 7 basic blocks (BB1-BB7), 2 if/else gates, 8 CFG edges
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: Seconds (s) and minutes (m) only; h token not supported

key_abstractions.mix_for_channel_flow: mix abstracts continuous-flow microfluidic channel injection events (not DMF droplet merging); annotated in source
key_abstractions.heat_for_iem_concentration: heat at 25c for 1200s models the 200 V DC IEM electrokinetic concentration step at ambient temperature (no thermal component)
key_abstractions.heat_for_saw_lysis: heat at 25c for 60s models the ~1 min SAW lysis channel residence time
key_abstractions.stranded_droplet_fix: lowIonicBuffer (PBS_01x) was dispensed but never consumed in original; removed in revision; PBS_01x dispensed inline as cvcBuffer1/cvcBuffer2 at point of use
